title:
VOLUME AND SURFACE AREA,
(SURFACE AREA OF CYLINDERS AND SPHERES)
objective: LO: I can calculate the surface area of cylinders and spheres using formulae.

key_terms.title: Surface area of cylinders and spheres

content.text: The surface area of a 3D shape is the total area of all its faces. A cylinder has two circular ends and a curved surface that unfolds into a rectangle. A sphere has a single curved surface.
Formulae: Cylinder SA = 2πr² + 2πrh. Sphere SA = 4πr². Always include units² in your answer.

examples.desc: four times the area of a great circle

key_idea.title: Key idea
key_idea.text: Surface area is the total area covering the outside of a 3D shape. Use the correct formula for each shape.
key_idea.caption: Two circular ends plus the curved surface area

modelled_examples.label: Example 1 – cylinder surface area
modelled_examples.question: Find the surface area of a cylinder with radius 5 cm and height 8 cm. Give your answer to 1 d.p.
modelled_examples.explanation: Add the area of both circles and the curved surface.

modelled_examples.label: Example 2 – sphere surface area
modelled_examples.question: Find the surface area of a sphere with radius 6 cm. Give your answer to 1 d.p.

modelled_examples.label: Example 3 – hemisphere surface area
modelled_examples.question: Find the total surface area of a solid hemisphere with radius 4 cm. Give your answer to 1 d.p.
modelled_examples.explanation: A solid hemisphere has a curved part plus a flat circular base.

modelled_examples.label: Example 4 – cylinder with no top
modelled_examples.question: A tin can (open top) has radius 3 cm and height 10 cm. Find the surface area to 1 d.p.
modelled_examples.explanation: Open-top means only one circular end is included.

practice.heading: Cylinder surface area

practice.heading: Sphere surface area
practice.instruction: Find the surface area of each sphere. Round to 1 d.p.

practice.heading: Hemispheres

practice.heading: Open cylinders

practice.heading: Mixed problems
practice.instruction: Solve each surface area problem. Round to 1 d.p.

items.statement: Cylinder SA = 2πr² + 2πrh includes both circles and the curved surface
The curved surface area of a cylinder equals 2πrh
A hemisphere has surface area exactly half of a full sphere
Surface area is always measured in square units

problems.text: A cylindrical water tank has radius 1.2 m and height 2 m. The outside (including top and base) needs painting. Paint covers 8 m² per litre and costs £7.50 per litre. Find the total cost of paint needed.

A solid shape is made from a hemisphere of radius 5 cm joined to a cylinder of the same radius and height 8 cm. Find the total surface area of the shape. (The join between hemisphere and cylinder is not an external surface.)
